subject: [PATCH 06/60] mm/memory_hotplug: migrate offlined pages to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a limitation in the current code where migration is only possible on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes. Proposed restricting the hot-unplug migration target-list to N_MEMORY_COMMON to ensure that it reflects the nodes the allocator can reach.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to migrate offlined pages to common memory, addressing a limitation in the current code where migration is only possible on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes. The destination nodemask starts with N_MEMORY and removes the source-node, leading to issues when migrating during partial offlining. To resolve this, the hot-unplug migration target-list is restricted to N_MEMORY_COMMON, ensuring that it reflects the nodes the allocator can reach.
